Daily Devotional

October 29

9 And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ: (Ephesians 3:9 KJV)

The mystery that Paul is talking about is Christ living in us (Galatians 4:6), and the fact that this new birth was not just for the Jews, but also for the Gentiles. It is still a mystery to us humans to think of almighty God, bigger than the universe, being able to live inside us. Solomon said when he finished the Temple of God, how can Almighty God live in a house that he built. That is nothing compared to the fact that God Almighty can, and does, live inside people that He created. We will understand it when we get to see Jesus (1 Corinthians 13:12), but now we must accept it by faith, as that is what pleases God (Hebrews 11:6). As much as we renew our minds now (Romans 12:2), we can begin to understand all the mysteries of God, as we, who are born again, have the mind of Christ in our new spirits (1 Corinthians 2:16). We need to draw it out by studying the Word.

This verse says that Jesus created all things, and that shows that Jesus is God, as God was the creator of all things (Genesis 1). This mystery of God the Father, Jesus the Son, and the Holy Ghost, all being One, is what we refer to as the Trinity. Us humans will never really understand these things until we get to heaven, as they are spiritual realities, and hard for us carnal humans to understand. Just know that the Word of God is true, and believe it with all your heart, and that faith will be pleasing to God, and keep your salvation from fading, as long as you obey Jesus (Hebrews 5:9). By keeping your mind on God and by reading and thinking on the Word of God, it will keep you walking close to Him. When you truly know God, it will bring you the peace and joy forever more.
